nodes.Name: writeGoFile
nodes.DocComment: writeGoFile writes a Go source file to a temp directory and returns its path.

nodes.Name: readFile
nodes.DocComment: readFile reads a file and returns its contents as a string.

nodes.Name: TestRewriteFunctionBody_PreservesSignature
nodes.DocComment:
TestRewriteFunctionBody_PreservesSignature verifies the "genius touch":
only the body is replaced, not the signature.

nodes.Name: TestRewriteFunctionBody_CreatesStubIfMissing
nodes.DocComment:
TestRewriteFunctionBody_CreatesStubIfMissing verifies that if the function
doesn't exist, a stub is created (the "invent new business logic" feature).

nodes.Name: TestRewriteFunctionBody_IdempotentBody
nodes.DocComment:
TestRewriteFunctionBody_IdempotentBody verifies that applying the same
body twice doesn't corrupt the file.

nodes.Name: TestRewriteFunctionBody_NonExistentFile
nodes.DocComment: TestRewriteFunctionBody_NonExistentFile verifies error on missing file.

nodes.Name: TestRewriteFunctionBody_InvalidBody
nodes.DocComment:
TestRewriteFunctionBody_InvalidBody verifies that invalid Go syntax in
the body returns an error rather than writing a broken file.

nodes.Name: TestUpsertRoute_AnchorInjection
nodes.DocComment: TestUpsertRoute_AnchorInjection verifies Strategy 1: anchor comment injection.

nodes.Name: TestUpsertRoute_Idempotent
nodes.DocComment:
TestUpsertRoute_Idempotent verifies that injecting the same route twice
doesn't duplicate it.

nodes.Name: TestUpsertRoute_FallbackInjection
nodes.DocComment:
TestUpsertRoute_FallbackInjection verifies Strategy 2: inject before
last closing brace when anchor comment is missing.
